_comment: Map controller inputs to actions. Action strings are listed in the README. Buttons are names: A B X Y LB RB LT RT VIEW MENU HOME L3 R3, plus D-UP D-DOWN D-LEFT D-RIGHT (the D-pad is buttons on Windows); aliases like L1 or START work too. Axes are LX LY (left stick) and RX RY (right stick). controller_profile (controllers/<profile>.json at the repo root) turns each name into the number your pad sends - if a name lands on the wrong button, fix the profile with 'uv run map_controller.py' rather than guessing numbers here. Plain numbers still work: bumpers 4/5 are kept as numbers because the profile's (unverified) Windows layout calls them VIEW/HOME - map the pad, then rename them. Run with --diagnose to print each button's number and name as you press it. Run --setup once to calibrate deadzone/axis_max for your controller, and --test to verify the sensitivity zones feel right.
